decisions.reason: The shared dark theme already applies to website pages; adding a header menu and related pages does not change the theme requirement.
A header menu can coexist with the shared footer and its links; the source does not remove or revise any footer content or behavior.
The source does not state that policy links move from the footer, change format, or change their new-tab access behavior.
The new website header menu and related pages do not change the branding or required visual elements of the Cognito sign-in page.
The source introduces no change to landing-page breakpoints, responsive behavior, or hero overlap handling.
The source separately discusses the Admin Workspace design, but the website header-navigation change does not alter the workspace shell requirement.
Adding website navigation and related pages does not necessarily change the landing-page build stack, and no implementation stack is specified in the source.
The source does not revise the landing page's section order, How It Works sequence, or copy plan.
The header-menu change neither removes nor modifies the landing-page sign-up call to action.
The source does not change the landing page's theme, colors, fonts, preferred concepts, or unresolved logo treatment.
The new header menu and related pages do not alter the landing-page hero emphasis or presentation.
The same message independently introduces production-ready solution-page diagrams, but the header-navigation modification does not change the diagram requirement.
